clips.title: The story
paras: On Blackthorn Ridge, Brine guides shaman initiates toward the spirits of water. This orc shaman teaches them to commune with the tides and earn their Water Totem.

Brine lives on a hill in northern Blackthorn Ridge, far from the Barrens' trading posts. Though dry savannas surround her, she has devoted her life to understanding water. Shaman across the Horde seek her wisdom after mastering earth and fire. She teaches that water calls for patience and perspective, qualities few understand as deeply as she does.

In her youth, Brine marched with her orc companions across the Hillsbrad Foothills and fought against human settlements. During the campaign, she came to Tarren Mill and found a humble well fed by fresh spring water. The well stayed in her memory as a sign of life amid devastation. It strengthened a lesson she had learned as a child: even in the darkest sorrow, a small token of hope can still be found.
